name: NetNomos
description: Generative ML models are increasingly popular in networking for tasks such as telemetry imputation, prediction, and synthetic trace generation. Despite their capabilities, they suffer from two shortcomings: \emph{(i)} their output is often visibly violating well-known networking rules, which undermines their trustworthiness; and \emph{(ii)} they are difficult to control, frequently requiring retraining even for minor changes.
